purpose: Runtime delivery layer for main-site pull, cache, revalidation, webhook, OpenAPI, and paged vocabulary access.

internal_sync_strategy.bundle: Used by main site backend/ISR cache warmer. Requires API key. Can include vocabulary only when explicitly requested.
internal_sync_strategy.delta: Used after publish/review/import jobs. Cursor must be persisted in knowledge_sync_cursors.
internal_sync_strategy.webhook: Optional push event after approved content changes; main site still validates by pulling delta.
